words.tr:
n. 调查；勘测；
v. 调查；勘测；
words.ex: The school did a survey about student lunch preferences.
words.ex_cn: 学校做了一项关于学生午餐偏好的调查。
words.en: A survey is a detailed study or inspection, especially as a means of collecting information about people's opinions or behavior.

words.ex: Good coordination between teams improves work efficiency.
words.ex_cn: 团队之间的良好协调能提高工作效率。
words.en: The organization of the different elements of a complex body or activity so as to enable them to work together effectively.

words.ex: The teacher gave an evaluation of the student's work.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生的作业进行了评估。
words.en: An evaluation is a judgment about how good, useful, or successful something is.

words.ex: The implementation of the new rule took one month.
words.ex_cn: 新规则的履行花了一个月。
words.en: The act of putting a decision or plan into effect; execution.

words.tr:
n. 性格外向者；爱交际的人
adj. 外向的
words.ex: He is an extrovert who loves talking to people.
words.ex_cn: 他是个外向的人，喜欢和人交谈。
words.en: An extrovert is someone who is very outgoing, sociable, and enjoys being around other people.

words.ex: He confesses that he made a mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他承认自己犯了一个错误。
words.en: If you confess to doing something, you admit that you did it.

words.tr: adv. 臭名昭著地；众所周知地；
words.ex: He notoriously breaks the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他臭名昭著地违反规则。
words.en: used to emphasize that a particular quality, fact, etc. is very well known, especially when it is bad

words.ex: Exercise can reinforce your muscles.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以增强你的肌肉。
words.en: To reinforce something means to make it stronger or more effective.

words.ex: The school changed its curriculum last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年学校更改了课程。
words.en: A curriculum is the subjects that are studied in a school, college, or university.

words.ex: His persuasion helped me change my mind.
words.ex_cn: 他的说服让我改变了主意。
words.en: Persuasion is the act of persuading someone to do something or to believe that something is true.

words.ex: The word 'home' has a warm connotation.
words.ex_cn: ‘家’这个词有温暖的含义。
words.en: An idea or feeling that a word invokes in addition to its literal or primary meaning.

words.ex: The flower has a sweet fragrance.
words.ex_cn: 这朵花有一种甜美的香味。
words.en: A fragrance is a pleasant smell, especially that of a flower or perfume.

words.ex: The class will commence at 9 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 课程将在上午9点开始。
words.en: To begin something; to start.

words.ex: His presence made everyone feel calm.
words.ex_cn: 他的存在让每个人都感到平静。
words.en: The state or fact of existing, occurring, or being present in a place or thing.

words.tr:
adj. 逐字的；一字不差的
adv. 逐字地；一字不差地
words.ex: He repeated the words verbatim.
words.ex_cn: 他一字不差地重复了那些话。
words.en: Using exactly the same words as were used originally.

words.ex: He has an associative memory that links colors to sounds.
words.ex_cn: 他有一种联想记忆，能把颜色和声音联系起来。
words.en: Relating to or resulting from association; involving the connection of ideas, feelings, or events.

words.tr: n. 层次体系；等级制度；
words.ex: The company has a clear hierarchy from manager to worker.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司有一个从经理到员工的明确层次体系。
words.en: A hierarchy is a system in which people or things are arranged according to their importance.

words.ex: He earned the esteem of his colleagues through hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他通过努力工作赢得了同事们的尊重。
words.en: If you esteem someone or something, you respect or admire them.

words.tr: n. 道德规范；伦理标准；
words.ex: The company follows a strong ethic of honesty.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司遵循诚实的道德规范。
words.en: An ethic is a moral principle or set of moral principles that guides the behavior of a person or group, especially in a professional context.

words.ex: The body has a mechanism to fight viruses.
words.ex_cn: 人体有一种对抗病毒的机制。
words.en: A mechanism is a part of a machine that does a particular task, or a system that is intended to achieve something or deal with a problem.

words.tr: adj. 真正的；真实的；真迹的；可靠的；
words.ex: This is an authentic painting by Picasso.
words.ex_cn: 这是一幅毕加索的真迹。
words.en: If something is authentic, it is real, true, or what people say it is.

words.ex: The mechanical toy moves with batteries.
words.ex_cn: 这个机械玩具用电池驱动。
words.en: Relating to machines or machinery; operated by or involving a machine or machines.

words.ex: Climbing the mountain was an arduous task.
words.ex_cn: 爬山是一项艰巨的任务。
words.en: Something that is arduous is difficult and tiring, and involves a lot of effort.

words.ex: The new car can outpace the old one.
words.ex_cn: 这辆新车能超过旧车。
words.en: To outpace someone or something means to perform a particular action faster or better than they do.

words.tr: phrase. 录取决定；指学校或机构对申请者是否被录取的最终决定
words.ex: He is waiting for the admissions decision from the university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在等待大学的录取决定。
words.en: An admissions decision is the outcome of the process by which an educational institution determines whether to accept an applicant.

words.tr:
n. 决策人；行政官；管理人员；
adj. 行政的；决策的；
words.ex: The executive decided to launch the new product.
words.ex_cn: 这位决策人决定推出新产品。
words.en: An executive is a person who has a senior management position in a business or other organization.

words.ex: The global climate conference was held in Paris.
words.ex_cn: 全球气候大会在巴黎举行。
words.en: A conference is a meeting of people who share the same interests or profession.

words.ex: The corporation sells smartphones worldwide.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司向全球销售智能手机。
words.en: A corporation is a large company or group of companies that is controlled together as a single organization.

words.ex: Many animals live in the tropics.
words.ex_cn: 许多动物生活在热带地区。
words.en: The tropics are the part of the Earth's surface that is closest to the equator, characterized by a hot climate.

words.tr: n. 朗诵；朗读；背诵；逐个叙述
words.ex: The boy did a recitation of the poem in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩在课堂上背诵了这首诗。
words.en: A recitation is the act of saying a piece of poetry or literature that you have learned to an audience.

words.tr: n. （宗教等的）仪式；（宗教等的）仪式( ritual的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The villagers perform morning rituals to honor their ancestors.
words.ex_cn: 村民们举行晨间仪式来纪念他们的祖先。
words.en: Rituals are a series of actions or type of behavior regularly and invariably followed by someone.

words.tr:
n. 刻板印象；陈规老套
v. 对…存有成见；把…模式化
words.ex: He broke the stereotype that boys cannot cry.
words.ex_cn: 他打破了男孩不能哭的刻板印象。
words.en: A stereotype is a fixed general image or set of characteristics that a lot of people believe represent a particular type of person or thing.

words.ex: The concept of freedom is important in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 自由这个观念在许多国家都很重要。
words.en: A concept is an idea or abstract principle.

words.ex: Good communication helps people understand each other.
words.ex_cn: 良好的交流有助于人们相互理解。
words.en: The imparting or exchanging of information by speaking, writing, or using some other medium.

words.ex: The word means different things in different context.
words.ex_cn: 这个词在不同的上下文中意思不同。
words.en: The context of an idea or event is the general situation that relates to it, and which helps it to be understood.

words.ex: The country's economy is growing fast.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家的经济正在快速增长。
words.en: The economy of a country or region is the system by which money, industry, and trade are organized.

words.ex: The scientist observe the birds every morning.
words.ex_cn: 科学家每天早上观察鸟类。
words.en: If you observe a person or thing, you watch them carefully, especially in order to learn something about them.

words.tr: n. 意思；意义； v. 表示…的意思；意思；“mean”的现在分词；
words.ex: What is the meaning of this word?
words.ex_cn: 这个词的意思是什么？
words.en: The meaning of something is what it expresses or represents.

words.ex: He speaks English as his first language.
words.ex_cn: 他说英语作为他的第一语言。
words.en: Language is the system of communication in speech and writing that is used by people of a particular country or area.

words.tr:
n. 材料；原料；
adj. 物质的；
words.ex: The table is made of wood material.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是由木头材料制成的。
words.en: Material refers to the substance or substances from which a thing is made or can be made, or information or ideas for use in creating a book or other work.

words.ex: His belief in honesty never changed.
words.ex_cn: 他对诚实的信念从未改变。
words.en: A belief is a strong feeling that something is true or exists.

words.ex: We had a short conversation about the weather.
words.ex_cn: 我们简短地聊了聊天气。
words.en: A conversation is a talk between two or more people, in which news and ideas are exchanged.

words.ex: His intention was to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他的意图是帮助他的朋友。
words.en: An intention is an idea or plan of what you are going to do.

words.ex: The word 'bank' has different semantic meanings.
words.ex_cn: 单词 'bank' 有不同的语义含义。
words.en: Semantic is used to describe something that relates to the meanings of words and sentences.

words.ex: His motivation is to help others.
words.ex_cn: 他的动机是帮助他人。
words.en: Motivation is the enthusiasm or reason for doing something.

words.ex: We had a discussion about homework.
words.ex_cn: 我们进行了一次关于作业的讨论。
words.en: A discussion is a conversation or debate about a specific topic.

words.tr: adj. 周围的； v. “surround”的现在分词；
words.ex: The surrounding trees block the wind.
words.ex_cn: 周围的树木挡住了风。
words.en: The area or environment around something or someone.

words.ex: He remained passive during the argument.
words.ex_cn: 他在争论中保持被动。
words.en: Accepting or allowing what happens or what others do, without active response or resistance.

words.tr: n. 学习；学问； v. 学习；“learn”的现在分词；
words.ex: Learning takes time and practice.
words.ex_cn: 学习需要时间和练习。
words.en: The acquisition of knowledge or skills through study, experience, or being taught.

words.ex: He submitted his application for the job last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周提交了那份工作申请。
words.en: An application is a formal request, often written, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something. It can also refer to the act of putting something to a special use or purpose, or a program or piece of software designed to perform a specific function.

words.ex: The teacher gave supervision to the students during the exam.
words.ex_cn: 老师在考试期间监督学生。
words.en: The act of overseeing or directing a project, activity, or person.

words.tr:
n. 模型；模特；模范；型号；
v. 将…做成模型；当模特；
words.ex: The architect built a model of the new building.
words.ex_cn: 建筑师制作了新大楼的模型。
words.en: A model is a person whose job is to wear and show new styles of clothes and other products, or a representation of something, often on a smaller scale, or a particular design or type of product.

words.ex: He faced racial discrimination at work.
words.ex_cn: 他在工作中遭遇了种族歧视。
words.en: Relating to the common characteristics of different races of people, especially in the context of social or cultural differences.

words.tr:
n. 压力；强调；
v. 着重；强调；
words.ex: He feels stress from too much work.
words.ex_cn: 他因为工作太多而感到压力。
words.en: Stress is a state of mental or emotional strain or tension resulting from adverse or demanding circumstances.

words.ex: The movie's depiction of ancient life is very realistic.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影对古代生活的描写非常真实。
words.en: A depiction of something is a picture or a written description of it.

words.tr:
n. 语音学
adj. 语音的；发音的
words.ex: He is learning phonetics to improve his pronunciation.
words.ex_cn: 他正在学习语音学以改善发音。
words.en: Phonetics is the study of the sounds of human speech.

words.ex: This is the latest version of the app.
words.ex_cn: 这是这个应用的最新版本。
words.en: A version of something is a particular form of it in which some details are different from earlier or later forms.

words.ex: He made a permanent change to his lifestyle.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的生活方式做出了永久的改变。
words.en: Something that is permanent exists or happens all the time, or exists for a long time without changing.

words.ex: The app has an interactive game for kids.
words.ex_cn: 这个应用有一个适合孩子的交互式游戏。
words.en: An interactive computer program or system is designed to involve the user in the exchange of information.

words.tr:
adj. 深思熟虑的；故意的；
v. 深思熟虑；
words.ex: He made a deliberate choice to quit his job.
words.ex_cn: 他深思熟虑后决定辞去工作。
words.en: If you do something that is deliberate, you planned or decided to do it beforehand, and so it happens on purpose rather than by chance.

words.ex: He finished his schooling at age 18.
words.ex_cn: 他18岁时完成了学业。
words.en: Schooling is the education that a person receives at school.

words.ex: His competence in math helped him solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学方面的能力帮助他解决了这个问题。
words.en: Competence is the ability to do something well or efficiently.

words.ex: The tribe lives in the forest and follows old traditions.
words.ex_cn: 这个部落住在森林里，遵循古老的传统。
words.en: A tribe is a social division in a traditional society consisting of families or communities linked by social, economic, religious, or blood ties, with a common culture and dialect, typically having a recognized leader.

words.ex: Globalization helps countries trade more easily.
words.ex_cn: 全球化帮助各国更容易地进行贸易。
words.en: The process by which businesses or other organizations develop international influence or start operating on an international scale.

words.ex: The farmer's cultivation of rice takes months.
words.ex_cn: 农民种植水稻需要几个月的时间。
words.en: The process of trying to acquire or develop a quality or skill.

words.tr:
n. 刻板印象；陈规老套
v. 对…存有成见；把…模式化
words.ex: He broke the stereotype that boys cannot cry.
words.ex_cn: 他打破了男孩不能哭的刻板印象。
words.en: A stereotype is a fixed general image or set of characteristics that a lot of people believe represent a particular type of person or thing.

words.ex: His argument was clear and logical.
words.ex_cn: 他的论点清晰而有逻辑。
words.en: An argument is a discussion or debate in which people express different opinions about something.

words.ex: Birds fly south by instinct.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类凭本能飞向南方。
words.en: An instinct is the natural tendency that a person or animal has to behave or react in a particular way.

words.ex: He took a temporary job during summer.
words.ex_cn: 他在暑假期间做了一份短暂的工作。
words.en: Something that is temporary lasts for only a limited time.

words.ex: The new legislation bans plastic bags.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法规禁止使用塑料袋。
words.en: Legislation refers to the process of making or enacting laws by a government or other authority.

words.ex: The government provides free education.
words.ex_cn: 政府提供免费教育。
words.en: The group of people who officially control a country or the system used for controlling a country.

words.ex: The massification of education makes it available to more people.
words.ex_cn: 教育的大众化使其惠及更多人。
words.en: The process of making something accessible or available to a large number of people.

words.ex: The child needs attention when he does homework.
words.ex_cn: 孩子做作业时需要被关注。
words.en: Attention is the act of focusing your mind on something and taking notice of it.

words.ex: This book belongs to the science category.
words.ex_cn: 这本书属于科学类别。
words.en: A category is a class or group of things that have similar characteristics.

words.tr:
n. 特点；特性；
adj. 典型的；特有的；
words.ex: Honesty is a key characteristic of a good friend.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是一个好朋友的关键特点。
words.en: A characteristic is a quality or feature that is typical of someone or something.

words.ex: He protects the environment by recycling.
words.ex_cn: 他通过回收利用来保护环境。
words.en: The environment is the natural world in which people, animals, and plants live.

words.ex: The learner practices English every day.
words.ex_cn: 这位学习者每天练习英语。
words.en: A learner is someone who is learning a particular subject or skill.

words.tr: n. 阅读；读物； v. 读；“read”的现在分词；
words.ex: Reading is an important skill for students.
words.ex_cn: 阅读是学生的重要技能。
words.en: The action or skill of reading written or printed matter silently or aloud.

words.ex: The weather varies from day to day.
words.ex_cn: 天气每天都在变化。
words.en: If things vary, they are different from each other in size, amount, or degree.

words.ex: After the experiment, we reached a conclusion.
words.ex_cn: 实验结束后，我们得出了一个结论。
words.en: A conclusion is the last part of something, its end or result.

words.tr:
n. 接触；联系；
v. 接触；联系；
words.ex: The two balls made contact when they collided.
words.ex_cn: 两个球在碰撞时发生了接触。
words.en: Contact refers to the act of communicating with someone, especially regularly, or the state of touching something.

words.ex: He is interested in politics.
words.ex_cn: 他对政治感兴趣。
words.en: Politics are the actions or activities concerned with achieving and using power in a country or society. The verb that follows politics may be either singular or plural.

words.ex: The media reported the news quickly.
words.ex_cn: 媒介迅速报道了这则新闻。
words.en: The main means of mass communication (broadcasting, publishing, and the Internet), regarded collectively.

words.ex: Social problems affect many families.
words.ex_cn: 社会问题影响许多家庭。
words.en: Social means relating to society or to the way society is organized.

words.ex: His response to the question was quick.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题的反应很快。
words.en: A reaction to a situation or event.

words.tr: adj. 至关重要的；决定性的；
words.ex: It is crucial to drink water every day.
words.ex_cn: 每天喝水至关重要。
words.en: If you describe something as crucial, you mean it is extremely important.

words.ex: The equation has two variables, x and y.
words.ex_cn: 这个方程有两个变量，x 和 y。
words.en: In mathematics and programming, a variable is a symbol used to represent an unknown or changeable value.

words.tr: v. 互相作用；互相影响；交流；沟通；
words.ex: The two chemicals interact when mixed.
words.ex_cn: 这两种化学物质混合时会互相作用。
words.en: If people interact with each other, they communicate or work together.

words.tr:
n. 研究；探索；调查；
v. 研究；调查；探讨；
words.ex: He did research on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他做了关于气候变化的研究。
words.en: Research is work that involves studying something and trying to discover facts about it.

words.tr:
adj. 客观的；
n. 目标；目的；
words.ex: He gave an objective opinion about the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他对这部电影给出了一个客观的看法。
words.en: An objective is something that you plan to do or achieve.

words.ex: He made a hypothesis that plants grow faster in light.
words.ex_cn: 他提出一个假设，认为植物在光照下长得更快。
words.en: A hypothesis is an idea which is suggested as a possible explanation for a particular situation or condition, but which has not yet been proved to be correct.

words.tr: adj. 实用的；实际的；实践的；
words.ex: This tool is practical for everyday use.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具日常使用很实用。
words.en: relating to what is real rather than to what is possible or imagined; likely to succeed or be effective in real circumstances; involving or concerned with experience or actual use; not theoretical

words.tr:
v. 集中；聚焦；
n. 中心点；焦点；
words.ex: He needs to focus on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他需要集中精力做作业。
words.en: If you focus on a particular topic or if your attention is focused on it, you concentrate on it and think about it, discuss it, or deal with it, rather than dealing with other topics.

words.tr:
n. 词；单词；话语；
v. 用词语表达；
words.ex: This word means 'happy' in English.
words.ex_cn: 这个词在英语中意思是‘高兴’。
words.en: A single unit of language that has meaning and can be spoken or written.

words.ex: I am familiar with this song.
words.ex_cn: 我熟悉这首歌。
words.en: If someone or something is familiar to you, you recognize them or know them well.

words.tr:
n. 工序；过程；
v. 处理；加工；
words.ex: The factory improved the production process.
words.ex_cn: 工厂改进了生产工序。
words.en: A process is a series of actions which are carried out in order to achieve a particular result.

words.ex: The school values diversity in its students.
words.ex_cn: 学校重视学生的多样性。
words.en: The state of being diverse; variety.

words.ex: The evolution of birds from dinosaurs took millions of years.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类从恐龙进化而来花了数百万年。
words.en: The gradual development of something, especially from a simple to a more complex form.

words.tr:
v. 回答；回应；
n. 回答；答案；
words.ex: He answered the question quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快回答了问题。
words.en: An answer is something that you say or write when you reply to a question or remark.

words.tr: adj. 引起兴趣的；引人入胜的； v. “intrigue”的现在分词；
words.ex: The mystery story was intriguing.
words.ex_cn: 这个侦探故事很引人入胜。
words.en: If you describe something as intriguing, you mean that it is interesting or strange.

words.ex: The rhythm of the music made everyone dance.
words.ex_cn: 音乐的节奏让所有人都跳起了舞。
words.en: A rhythm is a regular series of sounds or movements.

words.tr: phrase. 母语；本国语；本族语
words.ex: He speaks his mother tongue at home.
words.ex_cn: 他在家说他的母语。
words.en: The first language that a person learns to speak as a child; a person's native language.

words.ex: There was a controversy about the new school rules.
words.ex_cn: 关于新校规，人们展开了争论。
words.en: A controversy is a disagreement or argument about something that involves many people and generates strong feelings.

words.ex: His status in the company is very high.
words.ex_cn: 他在公司里的地位很高。
words.en: The status of someone or something is their position or situation according to the law or according to other people's opinions.

words.ex: English is a lingua franca in international business.
words.ex_cn: 英语是国际商务中的通用语言。
words.en: A lingua franca is a language or way of communicating which is used between people who do not speak one another's native language.

words.ex: He forgot the punctuation in his sentence.
words.ex_cn: 他忘记在句子中加标点符号了。
words.en: Punctuation refers to the marks used in writing to separate sentences and their elements and to clarify meaning.

words.ex: The linguist analyzed the English corpus to find common phrases.
words.ex_cn: 语言学家分析了英语语料库以寻找常用短语。
words.en: A corpus is a large collection of written or spoken texts that is used for language research.

words.tr:
n. 内容；含量；
adj. 满足的；
words.ex: The content of the video is very interesting.
words.ex_cn: 这个视频的内容非常有趣。
words.en: Content refers to the things that are held or included in something, or the state of being happy and satisfied.

words.ex: This region has many mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区有很多山。
words.en: A region is a large area of land that is different from other areas of land, for example because it is one of the different parts of a country with its own customs and characteristics, or because it has a particular geographical feature.

words.tr:
n. 媒介；方法；
adj. 中等的；适中的；
words.ex: TV is a popular medium for advertising.
words.ex_cn: 电视是一种流行的广告媒介。
words.en: A medium is a method or way of expressing something.

words.ex: The school changed its curriculum last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年学校更改了课程。
words.en: A curriculum is the subjects that are studied in a school, college, or university.

words.ex: His perception of the sound was very sharp.
words.ex_cn: 他对声音的感知非常敏锐。
words.en: Your perception of something is the way that you think about it or the impression you have of it.

words.ex: The police found evidence at the crime scene.
words.ex_cn: 警察在犯罪现场找到了证据。
words.en: Evidence is anything that you see, experience, read, or are told that causes you to believe that something is true or has really happened.

words.tr: adj. 常见的；普通的；共有的；
words.ex: Colds are a common illness in winter.
words.ex_cn: 感冒在冬天是很常见的疾病。
words.en: Something that is common happens often or is found in many places.

words.ex: The new machine improves the efficiency of production.
words.ex_cn: 这台新机器提高了生产的效率。
words.en: Efficiency is the ability to do something or produce something without wasting materials, time, or energy.

words.ex: The institutions help students learn math.
words.ex_cn: 这些机构帮助学生学习数学。
words.en: An institution is a large important organization such as a university, church, or bank.

words.tr: n. 含意；可能的影响（或后果）；暗示；
words.ex: The implication of his words was that he was sorry.
words.ex_cn: 他话中的含意是他很抱歉。
words.en: An implication is a possible future effect or result of an action or decision, often one that is not immediately obvious.

words.ex: He faced a dilemma: stay home or go to work.
words.ex_cn: 他面临一个困境：是待在家里还是去上班。
words.en: A situation in which a difficult choice has to be made between two or more alternatives, especially equally undesirable ones.

words.ex: His dominance in the game surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中的支配表现让所有人感到惊讶。
words.en: Dominance is the state of being more powerful, important, or noticeable than other people or things.

words.ex: They share intimacy through quiet talks at night.
words.ex_cn: 他们通过夜晚的安静交谈建立亲密感。
words.en: A close, familiar, and usually affectionate or loving personal relationship with another person or group.

words.ex: He has awareness of the environmental problems.
words.ex_cn: 他意识到环境问题。
words.en: Knowledge or perception of a situation or fact.

words.ex: The project aims to promote intercultural understanding.
words.ex_cn: 该项目旨在促进不同文化间的理解。
words.en: relating to or involving different cultures

words.ex: The origin of this tradition is unknown.
words.ex_cn: 这个传统的起源不明。
words.en: The origin of something is the point or place where it begins, or the cause from which it arises.

words.tr: n. 技能；技巧；技术；“skill”的复数；
words.ex: He developed many skills through practice.
words.ex_cn: 他通过练习掌握了多种技能。
words.en: Skills are the abilities and knowledge that you need in order to do a job or activity.

words.ex: The rainbow is a natural phenomenon.
words.ex_cn: 彩虹是一种自然现象。
words.en: A phenomenon is something that is observed to happen or exist, especially something that is unusual or interesting.

words.ex: Hormones control growth and mood in the body.
words.ex_cn: 荷尔蒙控制身体的生长和情绪。
words.en: A hormone is a chemical substance produced in the body that controls and regulates the activity of certain cells or organs.

words.ex: He speaks English with great fluency.
words.ex_cn: 他英语说得很流利。
words.en: Fluency is the ability to speak or write a language easily and well.

words.tr: n. 自主权；自治权；自治；
words.ex: The region demands autonomy from the central government.
words.ex_cn: 该地区要求从中央政府获得自主权。
words.en: Autonomy is the ability or condition of being self-governing; independence in one's thoughts or actions.

words.ex: The school has a disciplinary policy for students who break rules.
words.ex_cn: 学校对违反规则的学生有纪律规定。
words.en: Relating to discipline; enforcing or administering discipline.

words.tr:
n. 发展；进步；提前；
adj. 预先的；在前的；
v. 前进；发展；提前；
words.ex: The advance of technology has changed our lives.
words.ex_cn: 科技的发展改变了我们的生活。
words.en: If you advance a cause, interest, or claim, you support it and help it to succeed.

words.tr: n. 入会；入学 ；登记；注册；加入人数
words.ex: His enrollment in the club was approved last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周被批准加入该俱乐部。
words.en: The act of officially joining a course, school, etc., or the number of people who do this.

words.ex: His pronunciation of English words is very clear.
words.ex_cn: 他英语单词的发音非常清晰。
words.en: The way in which a word or a language is spoken.

words.ex: His words are a contradiction.
words.ex_cn: 他的话是矛盾的。
words.en: A contradiction is a situation or statement in which two aspects or elements are opposed to each other, making it impossible for both to be true at the same time.

words.ex: The clock shows accurate time.
words.ex_cn: 这个钟显示的时间很精确。
words.en: Correct in all details; exact.

words.ex: The government made a new regulation to control pollution.
words.ex_cn: 政府出台了一项新管理措施来控制污染。
words.en: A regulation is an official rule or order.

words.ex: The company values innovation in its products.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司重视产品的创新。
words.en: Innovation is the introduction of new ideas, methods, or things.

words.ex: He took responsibility for the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他承担了这个错误的责任。
words.en: If you have responsibility for something or someone, or if they are your responsibility, it is your job or duty to deal with them and to take decisions relating to them.

words.ex: He is learning English grammar every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都在学习英语语法。
words.en: Grammar is the system and structure of a language. The rules of grammar help us decide the order we put words in and which form of a word to use.

words.ex: His attitude toward homework is very positive.
words.ex_cn: 他对作业的态度非常积极。
words.en: An attitude is a way of thinking or feeling about something, which is often reflected in a person's behavior.

words.ex: His behavior at the party was very polite.
words.ex_cn: 他在派对上的举止非常礼貌。
words.en: The way in which one acts or conducts oneself, especially towards others.

words.ex: This math problem is difficult.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学题很难。
words.en: Something that is difficult is not easy to do, understand, or deal with.

words.ex: The teacher gave us important information about the test.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们关于考试的重要信息。
words.en: Information is facts or details about a subject, event, or situation.

words.ex: The professor gave a lecture on history.
words.ex_cn: 教授上了一节历史课。
words.en: A lecture is a talk that someone gives in order to teach people about a particular subject, often at a university or college.

words.ex: He practices his religion every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日都实践自己的宗教信仰。
words.en: Religion is the belief in and worship of a superhuman controlling power, especially a personal God or gods.

words.tr: n. 沉思；反射；反映；反省；
words.ex: He sat quietly in the garden for reflection.
words.ex_cn: 他静静地坐在花园里沉思。
words.en: A reflection is an image that you can see in a mirror, glass, or water.

words.ex: The two apples are different.
words.ex_cn: 这两个苹果不一样。
words.en: not the same as another or each other; unlike in nature, form, or quality

words.tr:
n. 结构；建筑物；
v. 组织；
words.ex: The structure of the bridge is very strong.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥的结构非常坚固。
words.en: The arrangement of and relations between the parts or elements of something complex.

words.tr:
n. 控制；管制；
v. 控制；操纵；
words.ex: The teacher has good control of the class.
words.ex_cn: 老师对课堂有很好的控制。
words.en: To control something means to have power over it and to be able to make it do what you want.

words.ex: His expression showed he was happy.
words.ex_cn: 他的表情显示他很快乐。
words.en: The act of making your thoughts, feelings, etc., known by speech, writing, or some other method.

words.tr:
n. 个人；
adj. 个别的；单独的；
words.ex: Each individual has the right to speak freely.
words.ex_cn: 每个人都有权自由发言。
words.en: An individual is a person considered separately from their society or community. As an adjective, it describes something that is single, separate, or unique to a person or thing.

words.ex: He loves reading English literature.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢阅读英语文学。
words.en: Literature consists of written works, especially those considered to have artistic or intellectual value.

words.tr:
adj. 学术的；
n. 大学教师；学者；
words.ex: He published an academic paper on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他发表了一篇关于气候变化的学术论文。
words.en: relating to education, especially at college or university level

words.ex: He read a historical book about ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 他读了一本关于古罗马的历史书。
words.en: Historical means relating to the study of history or connected with the past.

words.tr:
n. 特征；报刊特写；
v. 以…为特色；是…的重要组成；
words.ex: The main feature of this phone is its long battery life.
words.ex_cn: 这款手机的主要特征是续航时间长。
words.en: A feature of something is an interesting or important part or characteristic of it.

words.ex: I love learning about different cultures.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢了解不同的文化。
words.en: The ideas, customs, and social behavior of a particular people or society.

words.ex: He wore a formal suit to the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了一套正式的西装去参加婚礼。
words.en: Something that is formal is done or said according to an established or conventional way, especially in an official or serious situation.

words.ex: Ancient Egypt is one of the oldest civilizations.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及是最早的文明之一。
words.en: A civilization is a human society with its own social organization and culture.

words.ex: The teacher gave a simple interpretation of the poem.
words.ex_cn: 老师对这首诗做了一个简单的解释。
words.en: An interpretation of something is an explanation or understanding of it.

words.ex: From the clues, he made a logical inference.
words.ex_cn: 从线索中，他做出了一个合理的推论。
words.en: An inference is a conclusion that you draw about something by using information that you already have about it.

words.ex: I got your message this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我今天早上收到了你的消息。
words.en: A message is a piece of information or a request that you send to someone or leave for them when you cannot speak to them directly.

words.tr: n. 音调；语气；强健状况；色调；氛围；
words.ex: His tone sounded angry.
words.ex_cn: 他的音调听起来很生气。
words.en: The tone of a sound is its particular quality. In music, tone refers to the pitch of a note. In art, tone refers to the lightness or darkness of a color. In speech, tone refers to the quality of the voice which expresses the speaker's feelings or intentions.

words.tr:
n. 影响（力）；
v. 影响；
words.ex: The teacher had a big influence on her students.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生们有很大的影响。
words.en: The power to affect, control, or manipulate someone or something.

words.ex: The war ended last year.
words.ex_cn: 这场战争去年结束了。
words.en: A war is a period of fighting or conflict between countries or states.

words.ex: He wrote an essay about his summer trip.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于他暑假旅行的文章。
words.en: An essay is a short piece of writing on a particular subject.

words.tr: n. 需求；要求；必要条件；
words.ex: The job has a requirement of two years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作的要求是两年经验。
words.en: A requirement is something that is necessary or that must be done.

words.tr: v. 反映；反射；反省；思考；仔细考虑；
words.ex: The mirror reflects the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 镜子反射阳光。
words.en: If a surface reflects light, heat, sound, or an image, it sends the light, etc. back and does not absorb it. If something is reflected in a mirror or in water, you can see its image in the mirror or in the water.

words.tr: n. 观察；观测；注意；监视；(观察后的）意见；
words.ex: The scientist made an observation about the bird's behavior.
words.ex_cn: 科学家对这只鸟的行为进行了观察。
words.en: The act of noticing or watching something carefully in order to gain information.

words.ex: It is important to eat healthy food.
words.ex_cn: 吃健康的食物很重要。
words.en: Something that is important is very significant, is highly valued, or is necessary.

words.tr:
n. 文本；课文；
v. 发短信；
words.ex: He read the text carefully.
words.ex_cn: 他仔细阅读了文本。
words.en: Text refers to any written material, especially the main body of a book or other piece of writing, as distinct from illustrations, notes, or appendices.

words.ex: The scholar published a book about ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 这位学者出版了一本关于古代历史的书。
words.en: A scholar is a person who studies an academic subject and knows a lot about it.

words.ex: The teacher gave me feedback on my essay.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我关于我作文的反馈。
words.en: Feedback is comments in the form of opinions about and reactions to something, intended to provide useful information for future decisions and development.

words.ex: He is studying linguistics at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习语言学。
words.en: Linguistics is the scientific study of language and its structure, including the study of morphology, syntax, phonetics, and semantics.

words.tr: n. 理解；了解； v. “understand”的现在分词；
words.ex: His understanding of the problem helped solve it quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题的理解帮助快速解决了它。
words.en: An understanding is a mutual agreement or sympathy between people or groups.

words.ex: He felt psychological stress before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前感到心理压力。
words.en: Relating to the mental and emotional state of a person.

words.ex: He improved his vocabulary by reading every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天阅读来提高自己的词汇量。
words.en: The vocabulary of a person is all the words that they know or use in a particular language.

words.ex: The theory of gravity explains why things fall down.
words.ex_cn: 重力理论解释了为什么东西会往下掉。
words.en: A theory is a formal idea or set of ideas that is intended to explain something.

words.tr:
n. 兴趣；利息；利益；
v. 使产生兴趣；
words.ex: He has a strong interest in painting.
words.ex_cn: 他对绘画有浓厚的兴趣。
words.en: If you have an interest in something, you want to learn or hear more about it.

words.tr:
adj. 本土的；
n. 土著；本地人；
words.ex: This plant is native to Australia.
words.ex_cn: 这种植物原产于澳大利亚。
words.en: A native of a particular country or region is someone who was born in that country or region.

words.ex: His mood changed after he heard the good news.
words.ex_cn: 他听到这个好消息后，心情变了。
words.en: A mood is a temporary state of mind or feeling.

words.tr: n. 事件；大事；比赛项目；
words.ex: The school event was fun for everyone.
words.ex_cn: 学校的活动对每个人都很有趣。
words.en: An event is something that happens, especially when it is unusual or important.

words.tr:
n. 变化；变革；
v. 变化；变革；
words.ex: There was a big change in the weather.
words.ex_cn: 天气发生了很大的变化。
words.en: To make or become different; to alter or modify; to exchange or replace something with another.

words.ex: The teacher gave a comprehensive review before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 老师在考试前给了一个全面的复习。
words.en: Something that is comprehensive includes everything that is needed or relevant.

words.ex: The festival celebrates ethnic music and dance.
words.ex_cn: 这个节日庆祝民族音乐和舞蹈。
words.en: Ethnic relates to a group of people who have a common national or cultural tradition.

words.ex: The mode of transportation is a bike.
words.ex_cn: 出行的方式是骑自行车。
words.en: A mode is a particular way or style in which something is done or experienced.

words.ex: His acceptance of the offer made everyone happy.
words.ex_cn: 他接受了这份提议，让大家都很高兴。
words.en: The act of agreeing to receive or undertake something offered.

words.ex: His intonation made the sentence sound friendly.
words.ex_cn: 他的语调让这句话听起来很友好。
words.en: Intonation is the way the voice rises and falls in speech, especially the pitch pattern in a sentence.

words.ex: He learned syntax from his English teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他从英语老师那里学习了句法。
words.en: Syntax is the grammatical arrangement of words in a sentence.

words.ex: The country expanded its territory after the war.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家在战争后扩大了它的领土。
words.en: An area of land that is controlled by a particular country, ruler, or military force.

words.ex: His comprehension of the story was very good.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个故事的理解很好。
words.en: Comprehension is the ability to understand something.

words.ex: She is assertive when she speaks up for her rights.
words.ex_cn: 当她为自己权利发声时，表现得坚定自信。
words.en: Someone who is assertive behaves confidently and is not frightened to say what they want or believe.

words.ex: He showed strong emotion when he heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到这个消息时，表现出了强烈的情绪。
words.en: An emotion is a feeling such as happiness, love, fear, anger, or hatred, which can be caused by the situation that you are in or the people you are with.

words.ex: The situation is very serious.
words.ex_cn: 这种情况非常严重。
words.en: A situation is all the circumstances and things that are happening at a particular time and in a particular place.

words.ex: His involvement in the project helped it succeed.
words.ex_cn: 他参与这个项目帮助它取得了成功。
words.en: The act of taking part in something or the state of being connected with something.

words.tr:
n. 样品；样本；
v. 抽样；
words.ex: The scientist tested the sample from the river.
words.ex_cn: 科学家测试了来自河流的样品。
words.en: A sample is a small quantity of a product, especially food, given to customers so that they can try it before buying it.

words.ex: The indigenous people live in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 本土居民住在森林里。
words.en: Indigenous people or things belong to the country in which they are found, rather than coming there or being brought there from another country.

words.ex: The company follows ethical practices in hiring.
words.ex_cn: 该公司在招聘中遵循伦理规范。
words.en: Relating to moral principles or the branch of knowledge dealing with these.

words.tr: n. 获得；得到的东西；收购；
words.ex: The acquisition of new skills takes time.
words.ex_cn: 获得新技能需要时间。
words.en: An acquisition is something that someone buys, often to add to a collection of things.

words.ex: The solution to the problem is simple.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题的解决办法很简单。
words.en: A solution to a problem is a way of dealing with it so that the difficulty is removed.

words.ex: The company made a statement about the new policy.
words.ex_cn: 公司就新政策发布了一项声明。
words.en: A statement is something that you say or write which gives information in a formal or definite way.

words.ex: He sent an acknowledgement email after receiving the gift.
words.ex_cn: 他收到礼物后发了一封确认邮件。
words.en: An acknowledgement is a statement or action which recognizes that something exists or is true.

words.ex: He is literate and can read simple books.
words.ex_cn: 他有读写能力，能读简单的书。
words.en: A literate person is able to read and write, and has a good education.

words.ex: The shopkeeper will evaluate the old watch.
words.ex_cn: 店主将估价这块旧手表。
words.en: If you evaluate something or someone, you consider them in order to make a judgment about them, for example about how good or bad they are.

words.ex: The hotel gave us complimentary breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 酒店免费赠送了我们早餐。
words.en: If something is complimentary, it is given or done free of charge. It can also mean expressing a compliment; praising or approving.

words.tr: adj. 公正的；不偏不倚的；
words.ex: The judge was impartial in the trial.
words.ex_cn: 法官在审判中是公正的。
words.en: Someone who is impartial is not directly involved in a particular situation, and is therefore able to give a fair opinion or decision about it.

words.ex: The project failed due to a series of miscommunications.
words.ex_cn: 该项目因一系列的错误传达而失败。
words.en: Miscommunication refers to a failure to communicate effectively, leading to misunderstandings or the wrong message being conveyed.

words.ex: The child imitates her mother's voice.
words.ex_cn: 孩子模仿她妈妈的声音。
words.en: If you imitate someone, you copy what they do or produce.

words.tr:
n. 价值；（数）值；
v. 估价；重视；
words.ex: The value of this painting is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画的价值很高。
words.en: If you value something or someone, you think that they are important and you appreciate them.

words.ex: The police discovered a scheme to steal money.
words.ex_cn: 警方发现了一个偷钱的阴谋。
words.en: A scheme is a plan or arrangement, especially one produced by a government or other organization, or a secret plan to do something, especially something illegal or dishonest.
